svg.title: Smart Product Framework - End-to-End Sequence Flow

g.text: Smart Product Framework - End-to-End Sequence Flow
The exact factory represents one product specification.
It owns the payload schema, required resource types,
accepted indication categories, and deployment logic.
verify content hash and lock resource
verify content hash and lock resource
The text resources can also be published in one step
by supplying content and its expected hash to the constructor.
No product-type routing registry is required.
[assign curve indication to the product definition]
Indication assignment is optional registry metadata.
The current trade flow does not require or revalidate
verify provider, status, and terms hash
verify client, status, and agreed hash
apply XSLT to resolved product state
EvmXmlRenderer resolves XIncludes and evmstate bindings.
The frontend applies the documentation XSLT separately.
